Kanti+ reads the text of your notes, PDFs and worksheets on this phone, including scanned pages, so search finds what is written in them. Nothing is uploaded, and the stored text is deleted when you sign out.

Scans and photos: printed German text is recognised on this phone. Up to 60 scanned pages per document; turned pages are tried in every direction.

Handwriting: Kanti+ does not recognise handwriting itself. Handwritten notes are found through the transcript that FaNotes on a computer or tablet stores. Handwriting on scans is mostly not recognised.

resources.string: Kanti+ never reads Schulnetz in the background. The Kanti+ server reads it every few minutes on school days and sends a push as soon as something changed. The app only asks the server now and then whether it missed a push. Save battery asks less often.
New school changes arrive instantly by push. Kanti+ also checks about every %1$s for a missed one.
